painted_contrast.method: Sample actual background pixels beneath glyph positions using a paired Chromium capture with text temporarily hidden and geometry unchanged; compute relative luminance against the authored foreground. Final measurements use source CSS with no experimental overrides.
painted_contrast.before: Broad branded inner glows washed out some small/body text (sample minima2.57–4.17). This was fixed through the existing glass material.
painted_contrast.limit: Scoped rendered samples, not formal whole-site WCAG certification.
